description: Held-out tape for wave 1b (written before any w1b result was seen; not used for tuning). Mid zooms where the 201MP tier's buffered coverage does not fit the decoded budget (coverage == crop), with long at-rest holds: 2.5x interior hold, small 3x pans, 2x near the top edge, a 4x interior jump measured for sharpness, and a final 1.6x hold. x/y are fractions of the .poster-frame box.
